thesis: Royal Caribbean (NYSE: RCL). Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-10-27) read via WebFetch extraction of statements. Q3 revenue 5,591M (+8.8%), 9M revenue 14,876M (+8.8%), 9M NI attributable 3,798M (vs 3,514M, +8.1%). 9M OCF 5,274M, capex 3,880M, FCF 1,394M. Debt 22,872M gross vs cash 851M, equity 11,913M; maturities 579M rest of 2026, 2,371M 2027, 3,211M 2028. Close 296.48 (2026-11-20) x 267,470,925 shares = 79.3B = 17.4x TTM NI 4,552M; TTM FCF 1,510M = 1.9% yield. Stock fell 7.5% from 320.65 on 11-18 to 296.48 on 11-20; cause not researched.
counterthesis: Net debt about 22.0B against TTM FCF only 1.5B after heavy ship capex; earnings are cyclical and sensitive to consumer demand, fuel, and geopolitical events; 17x peak earnings is not cheap on cash. Share count and dilution, order book commitments, and customer deposits (a working capital source of OCF) not reviewed.
invalidation: Invalidated or downgraded if bookings or yields weaken, if the order book commitments outrun cash generation, or if refinancing of the 2027-2028 maturities (5.6B) becomes costly.
